articles.title: Heavy Rain Floods the Four Corners Region
articles.summary: Heavy rain has flooded parts of four western states, forcing evacuations, while officials warn more rain may come through Sunday.

articles.title: Two Men Named Dan Sullivan Are on Alaska's Senate Ballot
articles.summary: Trump says he ordered a lawsuit that could stop Alaska's Senate result from being confirmed if the Republican incumbent loses.

articles.title: U.S. Plans Tighter Rules on High-Tech Money Sent Abroad
articles.summary: Treasury has proposed wider limits on U.S. high-tech investments in countries of concern, but the rule is not final yet.
